author: Ronald Murchison
text: Someone complains about being denied quite a bit. I was denied once, but that was because the sensor i tried to replace because it didn't start had expired. Legit denial.

author: Ray Rooney
text:
It's within range, especially given time gaps. Yeah, it's annoying, but they have to draw a line somewhere. 

It's why you should always keep a regular meter handy. It prevents you from doing the wrong thing when you get a false out-of-range reading.

Most are momentary spikes anyway. Digital noise.

Imagine life when we didn't have either.
